title: Prepare aps v1.1.0 atomically: build and test a portable Linux bundle, align Homebrew and installer asset contracts, synchronize every public version surface, and adopt tofu-ux/0x as the site design-system source
description: Prepare aps v1.1.0 atomically: build and test a portable Linux bundle, align Homebrew and installer asset contracts, synchronize every public version surface, and adopt tofu-ux/0x as the site design-system source
acceptance_criteria: The Linux release executable is built with $ORIGIN/lib before archival; readelf verifies the archived rpath; a clean Linux container runs the extracted bundle without Swift; the installer verifies the archive checksum and preserves aps plus lib; release, installer, Homebrew template, and formula workflow use aps-linux-x86_64-portable.tar.gz; Homebrew installs the Linux bundle under libexec and exposes a wrapper; VERSION and every runtime, schema, test, smoke, plugin, spec, README, docs, and site version surface agree on 1.1.0; a deterministic version-contract test fails on drift; fledge release minor --no-bump --dry-run targets v1.1.0 without edits; the site imports the pinned upstream tofu-ux/0x tokens and components, implements the standard no-flash accessible theme toggle, preserves aps-specific state-tape identity, and passes lint, static hosting builds, rendered-output tests, and accessibility checks; SpecSync strict, Fledge verify, and Trust all pass without bypass.
